name: Extract anatomical statistics inside data mapped to cortical surface
summary: Computes FreeSurfer anatomical statistics (vertex count, surface area, gray matter volume, thickness, curvature) inside thresholded maps on the cortical surface from a cortexmap, and outputs a CSV.
description: Thresholds each map in the cortexmap func directory (values above threshold) into a surface label with Connectome Workbench, converts the labels to FreeSurfer annotations and runs mris_anatomical_stats and mri_segstats on curvature for each one; results are merged into parc-stats/cortex-mapped-anatomical-stats.csv. Use it to get the morphometry of cortex covered by any surface-mapped data. Needs a cortexmap and the FreeSurfer subject directory of the same subject.

inputs.description: Cortexmap whose func/ directory holds the per-hemisphere surface maps (.func.gii) to threshold, and whose surf/ directory holds the white surfaces.
FreeSurfer subject directory of the same subject, used for anatomical and curvature statistics.

outputs.description: cortex-mapped-anatomical-stats.csv with one row per thresholded map: vertex count, surface area, gray matter volume, thickness, curvature indices and curvature summary.
Intermediate thresholded maps, label files and per-label statistics text files.

parameters.description: Value above which a vertex of a map is included in that map's label.

failure_modes.cause: No FreeSurfer license in the environment.
failure_modes.fix: Set the FREESURFER_LICENSE environment variable on the compute resource.

failure_modes.message: something went wrong. check logs and derivatives
failure_modes.cause: The output CSV was not produced.
failure_modes.fix: Check the job log and raw derivatives.
